detail.longDescription:
Chat AI is an all-in-one AI chatbot and AI assistant, built on multiple AI models in one app. Start an AI chat, ask anything and get help with writing, studying, images, documents and everyday questions, all in a single conversation.

🤖 ONE AI CHATBOT, THE LATEST AI MODELS
Chat AI is built on the latest AI models, including GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Grok 4.7, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3, all available in Chat AI. Pick the model that fits your task and switch at any time in the same AI chat, without starting over. With this all-in-one setup, you don’t need a separate app for each model. Chat with AI using text, photos or your voice, because Chat AI is multimodal AI that understands more than words.

✍️ AI WRITER FOR EVERY TEXT
Write essays, emails, stories, captions and blog posts with an AI writer that adapts to your tone. Share a rough idea and your assistant turns it into an outline, a first draft or a polished final version. Rewrite, shorten or expand any text, and ask for a new version until it sounds just right.

🎓 HOMEWORK HELP AND STUDY SUPPORT
Get homework help in any subject, from history and biology to languages. Snap a photo of a math problem and see the solution step by step, so you understand how to solve the next one on your own. Before an exam, ask your assistant for clear explanations and practice questions on any topic.

🎨 AI IMAGE GENERATOR AND IMAGE TRANSFORMER
Turn any idea into a picture with the AI image generator. Describe a scene, a character or a place you have never been, and get artwork for social media posts, book covers, postcards, wallpapers or logo ideas. Not quite right? Ask for changes in the same chat, like a new color, mood or composition, and create a fresh version in a moment.
With the AI image transformer, start from your own photo instead. Upload a selfie or any picture and transform it into a new style, from retro portraits to seasonal looks, with simple image-to-image prompts. Snap a photo of a building, an artwork or a landscape and get instant info about it, too.
For everyone’s safety, Chat AI does not generate or transform images with sexual content, self-harm or other harmful material.

📄 CHAT WITH PDF AND SUMMARIES
Upload a PDF or a document, paste a web link or a video link, then ask questions and get clear answers. Get the key points of long videos, articles and reports as short summaries you can read in a minute.

🎙️ VOICE CHAT
Talk to AI hands-free with voice chat. Ask questions while you cook, practice a new language out loud or think through ideas on a walk, and the chatbot answers in a natural conversation.

🌐 AI SEARCH AND WEB BROWSING
Chat AI can browse the web for you. Use AI search to look up current info, from tech news to travel tips, and get a clear summary instead of a list of links. Paste a web page or an article link and ask what it says, then turn any AI search into a follow-up conversation and keep asking until you have what you need.

Your AI assistant works like an AI agent for everyday tasks, powered by artificial intelligence that keeps context across the conversation. Chat AI brings an AI chatbot, AI assistant and AI agent together in one all-in-one app. Download Chat AI, start a new AI chat and ask AI anything. Every AI chat stays in one place.

ℹ️ ALL-IN-ONE AI CHATBOT DISCLAIMER
Chat AI is an independent AI chatbot app built on third-party AI models. GPT models are created by OpenAI, Gemini by Google, Claude by Anthropic, Grok by xAI, DeepSeek by DeepSeek and Kimi by Moonshot AI. Chat AI did not create these models, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by these companies. Each model name and trademark remains the property of its owner.
